Her EMDF harness strains until its protective shimmer cracks like shattered glass under the immediate feedback load.

The informational strike instantly transforms into a physical breach of Conduit Gamma-7. Superheated plasma, corrosive haze, and the deep rhythmic vibration from the core surge outwards in a focused blast—a perfect, calculated blowback against your attempt to disrupt its existence.

Helena Cross throws her arms up, momentarily shielding herself from the blast. She stares at the console as a critical alert overrides all other metrics: "Gamma-7 Integrity Zero Percent." Her voice is strained by the environmental assault, but surgically precise even under fire. "The paradox failed; the Entity used it to destabilize our structural matrix."

Critical life support redundancy in Sector Two—the buffer Helena was monitoring just moments ago—suffers a sudden, violent depletion. The station's central systems scream a new, more profound alarm: the containment failure has become an active, system-wide systemic collapse.
